name: kakao-map
description: 주소↔좌표 변환 · 장소 검색(키워드/카테고리) · 대중교통·도보·자전거 길찾기 · 정적 지도 PNG — 카카오 지도 통합. REST API (geocoding·역지오코딩·주소 검색·키워드 검색) + JavaScript SDK 키 (render_map 컴포넌트가 사용). South Korea 전용. South Korea 외 지역은 render_map 의 Leaflet 폴백.

action.description: geocoding/search-address=address to coordinates, reverse-geocoding=coordinates to address, coord2region=coordinates to administrative (H) and legal (B) division codes, transcoord=between coordinate systems, search-keyword=places by name, search-category=places by category code with no keyword, route-transit/route-walk/route-bicycle=directions, static-map=a PNG of the map, for documents and notifications where an interactive map cannot go

address.description: [geocoding/search-address] 주소 또는 검색어 (예: '서울 강남구 역삼동' 또는 '강남역')

addresses.description: [geocoding] batch mode — multiple addresses in ONE call (max 30). Use this instead of N single calls when placing many markers (e.g. apartment complexes). Returns results[] with {query, items} per address.

keywords.description: [search-keyword] batch mode — multiple place keywords in ONE call (max 30). Use this instead of N single calls when locating many places (e.g. apartment complex names for map markers). Shares lat_center/lon_center/radius/categoryGroupCode. Returns results[] with {query, items} per keyword.

categoryGroupCode.description: [search-keyword/search-category] Category group. Required for search-category, optional as a filter for search-keyword. MT1=대형마트, CS2=편의점, PS3=어린이집·유치원, SC4=학교, AC5=학원, PK6=주차장, OL7=주유소·충전소, SW8=지하철역, BK9=은행, CT1=문화시설, AG2=중개업소, PO3=공공기관, AT4=관광명소, AD5=숙박, FD6=음식점, CE7=카페, HP8=병원, PM9=약국

radius.description: [search-keyword] 검색 반경 m (lat_center/lon_center 와 같이. max 20000)

limit.description: [search-*] Results per page. The cap differs per endpoint and is NOT 45 (that is the page cap): address search takes 30, place and category search take 15. Over-asking is a 400, so it is capped here and reported.

rect.description: [search-category] Rectangular search area as "leftX,leftY,rightX,rightY". An alternative to centre plus radius; one of the two is required

sort.description: [search-category] accuracy (default) or distance. distance needs lat_center/lon_center — without them the vendor rejects the call

x.description: [transcoord] X value in `inputCoord` units. Not necessarily a longitude — TM and WTM are metres

inputCoord.description: [coord2region/transcoord/route-*] Coordinate system of the input (default WGS84). Local endpoints take WGS84|WCONGNAMUL|CONGNAMUL|WTM|TM|KTM|UTM|BESSEL|WKTM|WUTM; routing takes only WGS84|WTM|TM|WCONGNAMUL

outputCoord.description: [coord2region/transcoord/route-*] Coordinate system of the response. Required for transcoord

startName.description: [route-*] Origin label shown in the guidance (default 출발)

via.description: [route-walk/route-bicycle] Up to 5 waypoints. Transit routing does not take them

routeMode.description: [route-walk/route-bicycle] Search preference. Walk takes BROAD_FIRST (default) | SHORTEST | ACCESSIBLE; bicycle takes BIKE_ONLY (default) | SHORTEST | ACCESSIBLE. Transit has none

includePath.description: [route-*] Keep the step geometry. Those point arrays are most of the response and also what draws the route on a map, so they are kept by default; set false when only distance, time and guidance are wanted

centerLat.description: [static-map] Map centre latitude. Either this pair or `markers` is required

excludeFromBounds.description: Leave this marker out when the map auto-fits its view

markers.description: [static-map] Up to 5 markers. Supplying them lets the centre and zoom be worked out automatically

width.description: [static-map] Image width in pixels, up to 2048

height.description: [static-map] Image height in pixels, up to 1024

level.description: [static-map] Zoom level 1-15 (default 3). Lower is closer in

scale.description: [static-map] Pixel density. 2 (default) returns an image twice the requested size

logoPos.description: [static-map] Where the Kakao logo sits. It is burned into the image and cannot be removed, only moved

coord.description: [static-map] Coordinate system of the supplied centre and markers (default WGS84)

name.description: [static-map] File name stem for the saved image. Defaults to a name built from the coordinates

items.description: 결과 목록. action 별 다름. geocoding/search-address: address_name·road_address_name·x(경도)·y(위도). search-keyword: place_name·category_name·road_address_name·phone·x·y·distance
